title: How do I bill a Corporate Wellness Partnership reinstatement fee?
content:
A reinstatement fee may only be billed once the employer's master account no longer shows any outstanding missed-payment balance for this enrollment. Once that holds, billing the fee for a Corporate Wellness Partnership enrollment increases the net amount currently owed by the employer's master account (unless the fee computes to zero), adds a dues-billed entry to the enrollment's billing history, and moves the enrollment's lifecycle status from suspended to active in the same action.

This is done using an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): bill_corp_reinstatement_fee_377eb087.

Parameters:
- enrollment_id — the reference number of the enrollment being reinstated, read from the enrollment record.
- amount_usd — the dollar amount of the reinstatement fee, in USD, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places; pass 0.00 when the enrollment's reinstatement fee has been waived.

Return: a confirmation of the new billing-history entry's reference number, the reinstatement fee amount billed, the enrollment's resulting balance owed by the employer's master account, and that its lifecycle status is now active. No error condition beyond an unrecognized enrollment reference is defined for this action.
